selection: First four lexicographically sorted TRAIN world IDs, both languages; original, swapped_values, wrong_subject. Eight value pairs and eight subject-only pairs. No development-set selection or LoCoMo.

value_objectives.old: Mean of the two original weighted role losses divided by mean sample weight; complete teacher-forced reply CE and initial state CE
value_objectives.focused: Mean initial state CE plus mean full-vocabulary CE at the first differing reference value token, using the common reference prefix
value_objectives.paired: focused + softplus(1 - d), where d = (zA[a]-zA[b]) - (zB[a]-zB[b]); contrast alone is NOT sufficient

subject_objectives.old: Original role losses of swapped_values and wrong_subject, weighted 2:1, divided by sum of weights
subject_objectives.balanced: Equal mean of both original unweighted state and branch losses; correct subject versus wrong subject at the SAME city
subject_objectives.paired: balanced + softplus(1 - d), where d = (supported-insufficient)_matched - (supported-insufficient)_wrong at initial prefill

observations: Raw objective gradient norm and group norms; directional derivatives of d, common center c, both correct-side margins, and both full-vocabulary target-versus-current-best-other margins along NEGATIVE UNIT-L2 Euclidean objective gradient. Gradient cosine against old objective. No AdamW trajectory prediction, no learning-rate selection.

finite_difference.selection: First selected train world, both languages, all three objectives for value and subject
finite_difference.method: Symmetric temporary parameter perturbations; rebuild forward each time and restore exact original tensors in finally; no optimizer, checkpoint save or best-perturbation selection
finite_difference.scope: Fixed verified frozen C features and frozen output head, Python neural branch only. Not a new live-C finite-difference certificate.

reporting: All fixed pairs, objectives, numerical failures and both-sided failures retained. Target IDs and reference prefixes are diagnostic supervision, not serving inputs. Teacher forcing and existing train cities prohibit claims of free recall or unseen-value generalization.
